subject.title: Support setup codes with separate frontend and API origins

question: Should ClickClack officially support separate public frontend and API origins and API base paths through an exact server-issued setup-code claim endpoint?
rationale: Current architecture and documentation center one application origin, while this proposal adds configuration, deployment, security, OpenAPI, SDK, frontend, and OpenClaw consumer behavior that automation cannot select safely.

options.title: Adopt exact endpoint contract
options.body: Add a separate canonical API URL, emit an exact validated claim endpoint, return the API base URL after claiming, and preserve same-origin compatibility.

options.title: Support split origins only
options.body: Allow a separate API origin but retain the root-mounted `/api` contract and explicitly defer base-path deployments.

options.title: Keep one public origin
options.body: Continue supporting reverse-proxy routing as the deployment model and document separate public origins as unsupported.

recommendation.title: Adopt exact endpoint contract
recommendation.body: Add a separate canonical API URL, emit an exact validated claim endpoint, return the API base URL after claiming, and preserve same-origin compatibility.

likelyOwner.reason: Available history connects this person most directly to repository-wide deployment-origin and authentication decisions.
